Indraprastha Institute of Aeronautics vs SAITM for B.Tech is a thin comparison on one side. IIA is listed with a B.Tech + AME programme, but no fee or placement row.

sections.heading: Indraprastha Institute of Aeronautics vs SAITM for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose SAITM if you want the only recorded fee and placement data on this page. Our records list B.Tech tuition of ₹98,500 a year, JEE Main as the listed exam, and a 2021 row with an average package of ₹4 lakh and a highest package of ₹12 lakh.

Indraprastha Institute of Aeronautics cannot be ranked on fees or placements here, because both are missing. The institute is listed with a B.Tech + AME programme. Get the official fee circular and placement report before you compare it with SAITM.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: SAITM has recorded B.Tech tuition of ₹98,500 a year on several branches, including computer science and mechanical engineering. Treat this as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed four-year total, until you check the official circular.
A recorded application fee of ₹500 also appears against B.Tech Mechanical Engineering. That is not programme tuition, and this page does not use it as the course fee.
Indraprastha Institute of Aeronautics has no fee row on this page. Do not guess the B.Tech + AME fee.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: SAITM's latest recorded year on this page is 2021, with an average package of ₹4 lakh and a highest package of ₹12 lakh, listed against B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering. A 2020 row is also present, with an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹10 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.
Indraprastha Institute of Aeronautics has no placement row on this page. Ask the institute for its latest official report.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: SAITM has JEE Main listed in our records on this page. Confirm the official admissions notice for any state counselling or management-quota process.
Indraprastha Institute of Aeronautics has no exam listed here. Read the official B.Tech + AME admissions page for eligibility and any licence or DGCA-related requirement.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Indraprastha Institute of Aeronautics is listed at Sector 77, Delhi-Jaipur National Highway, Gurgaon. SAITM is listed at Khurrampur, Farrukh Nagar, Haily Mandi Road, Gurgaon.
These are different Gurgaon locations. Visit both if commute or the AME component will decide the choice.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want recorded B.Tech tuition and a 2021 placement row, SAITM is the side we can quote, at ₹98,500 a year and a ₹4 lakh average, after you confirm the official circular.
If you specifically want a B.Tech + AME pathway at Indraprastha Institute of Aeronautics, you must get the official fee and placement report, because both are missing here.
Do not use the ₹500 application fee as programme tuition.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Indraprastha Institute of Aeronautics or SAITM, for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: SAITM has recorded tuition of ₹98,500 a year, JEE Main listed, and 2021 figures of a ₹4 lakh average and a ₹12 lakh highest package. Indraprastha Institute of Aeronautics has a listed B.Tech + AME programme but no fee or placement record on this page.

faqs.question: What is the recorded SAITM B.Tech fee?
faqs.answer: Our records list tuition of ₹98,500 a year. A ₹500 application fee also appears; that is not programme tuition.

faqs.question: Does Indraprastha Institute of Aeronautics have a fee on this page?
faqs.answer: No. There is no fee row for the listed B.Tech + AME programme. Confirm the official circular.

faqs.question: How recent are the SAITM placements?
faqs.answer: The latest recorded year here is 2021, with an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹12 lakh. A 2020 row is also present. Ask the institute for a later official report if one exists.

faqs.question: Which entrance exam is listed?
faqs.answer: JEE Main is listed for SAITM. Indraprastha Institute of Aeronautics has no exam listed on this page. Check each official admissions notice.
